name: 25 let spustya
source:
Semyon receives a letter from the beautiful and sweet, but now dead, camp decades after having last visited it. A mysterious person demands that he return, remember the past, and capture its final moments. In exchange, they promise answers: to reveal the secret of '83. But what is this all for? What is the secret of '83? Who is this person? You will find out as soon as you step past the gates of the abandoned pioneer camp.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2446808980]Steam[/url]]
translation:
谢苗收到了一封来自美丽而甜蜜但现在已经死了的营地的信，距上次访问营地已有几十年了。一个神秘人要求他回来，记住过去，并捕捉它的最后时刻。作为交换，他们承诺给出答案：揭露83年的秘密。但这一切是为了什么？83年的秘密是什么？这个人是谁？当你跨过废弃拓荒者营地的大门时，你就会发现。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2446808980]Steam[/url]]
